The '''MC95E Star Cruiser''' was a class of [[Mon Calamari]] [[Star Cruiser]] that was active during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic]], and subsequently during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war between]] the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. At least one MC95E [[Star]] [[Cruiser]] participated in the [[Battle of Var-Shaa]] against the Empire as part of a [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] contingent. [[Standard decade|Decades]] later, many MC95E [[Star]] [[Cruiser]]s were present on [[Exegol]] as part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] in [[35 ABY]] between the Resistance and the [[Sith Eternal]].

==Description==
[[File:MC95E_Star_Cruiser_angle_1.png|thumb|left|200px|Side view of an MC95E Star Cruiser]]
The MC95E [[Star Cruiser]] was a class of [[Star]] [[Cruiser]]<ref name="Ship ST" /> of [[Mon Calamari]] design.<ref name="A Final Alliance" /> The MC95E Star Cruiser<ref name="Ship ST" /> was flatter than other Mon Calamari models, and was fitted with at least two [[hangar]] bays towards the bow of the vessel.<ref name="A Final Alliance" /> It was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]], which gave it the capability of entering [[hyperspace]] at [[lightspeed]], and was equipped with [[engine]]s.<ref name="Episode IX" />

Similar to other Mon Calamari ship designs,<ref name="A Final Alliance" /> the MC95E Star Cruiser<ref name="Ship ST" /> had a bulbous [[hull]] with differing surface modules, and had several [[antenna]] on a dorsal module towards the rear as well as forward-facing antenna at the bow of the ship near an ordnance pod. The ship's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was located on the forward command section near the bow of the vessel, and also contained a command tower towards the rear of the vessel. It was armed with several [[laser cannon]]s<ref name="A Final Alliance" /> with at least several being able to fire forward.<ref name="Hunted" /> The MC95E Star Cruiser<ref name="Ship ST" /> could be disabled when struck by powerful [[Force lightning]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Role==
As a [[capital ship]], the MC95E Star Cruiser had the ability to participate in [[Space warfare|naval warfare]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==History==
===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:MC95E-Star-Cruiser-Hunted.png|thumb|right|240px|An MC95E Star Cruiser of the New Republic participated in the Battle of Var-Shaa, alongside an MC75 Star Cruiser and an MC80 Star Cruiser.]]
MC95E Star Cruisers were in service by the [[time]] of the [[New Republic]]'s founding during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Hunted" /> between [[4 ABY]] and [[5 ABY]].<ref name="Note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that the [[New Republic]] was formed in [[4 ABY]] while the [[Galactic Civil War]] ended in [[5 ABY]]. Since the MC95E [[Star Cruiser]] was active by the time of the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War, it must have been active during these dates.</ref> One MC95E Star Cruiser participated as part of a [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] group that included other ships such as an [[MC75 Star Cruiser]], an [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80 ''Liberty'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser]], an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], three [[CR90 corvette]]s, and two [[GR-75 medium transport]]s. The fleet participated in the [[Battle of Var-Shaa]] against the [[Imperial Navy]], resulting in the destruction of the [[Var-Shaa dockyard]] and the retreat of the surviving Imperial forces.<ref name="Hunted" />

===First Order/Resistance war===
MC95E Star Cruisers remained in service by the time of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war between]]<ref name="Episode IX" /> the [[First Order]], a military junta that succeeded the fallen Old Galactic Empire, and the [[Resistance]], a paramilitary force with roots to the dissolved [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] and the defunct New Republic.<ref name="BFA">''[[Before the Awakening]]''</ref> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Exegol Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' as taking place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> Alliance and Republic heroes [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca]] were dispatched on the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' to rally the citizens of [[the galaxy]] in order to reinforce the Resistance, which had traveled to the ancient [[Sith]] redoubt [[Planet|world]] of [[Exegol]] in an attempt to defeat the resurgent [[Sith Eternal]], who allied itself with the First Order, and save the [[galaxy]] from their rule.<ref name="Episode IX" />

[[File:MC95E_Star_Cruiser_angle_2.png|thumb|left|225px|Midship section of the MC95E Star Cruiser.]]
As the Resistance came close to defeat and suffered heavy losses, an enormous [[Citizens' Fleet]] of 14,000 vessels from across the galaxy arrived at Exegol and participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]], including numerous MC95E Star Cruisers. Reinforced, the combined galactic force and the Resistance attacked the [[Final Order]], the Sith Eternal's massive fleet of planet-[[Death|killing]] [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] that numbered above 1,000 ships. As the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and [[Ben Solo]] confronted the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]] on the surface, [[Darth]] Sidious gained [[The Force|Force power]] from the [[Force dyad]] between Rey and Solo, and unleashed a torrent of powerful Force lightning at the galactic fleet, disabling many vessels.<ref name="Episode IX" />

After Rey continued her confrontation, the lightning dissipated and the fleet regained its foothold. Darth Sidious was then eventually disintegrated by his own power after Rey deflected his lightning, finally killing him. The remaining Sith [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] on Exegol were destroyed, and the citizens' fleet retreated to [[Ajan Kloss]] while an [[uprising against the First Order]] took place throughout the galaxy.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MC95E_Star_Cruiser.png|thumb|right|180px|An MC95E Star Cruiser at Exegol.]]
The MC95E Star Cruiser first appeared in the final installment of the [[Star Wars saga|''Star Wars'' saga]] and the [[sequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Episode IX" /> It was first identified in an installment of ''[[Star Wars By the Numbers]]'' on [[StarWarsKids.com]] in [[2020]].<ref name="Ship ST" /> The MC95E Star Cruiser appeared in the CG short "[[Hunted]]" as part of the promotional campaign for the 2020 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]''. In one scene, an [[MC95 Star Cruiser]] is shown in place of the MC95E Star Cruiser that appeared in multiple scenes.<ref name="Hunted" />
